editorial.blurb: This beloved family-owned Korean spot delivers authentic, crave-worthy dishes that keep regulars coming back—standout Japchae and spicy rabokki included.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for lunch or dinner and expect food to arrive fast; order the sundubu (available with seafood or beef) and the rabokki if you like heat, and arrive with an appetite to explore their full menu.

topDishes.note: Probably the best reviewers have had—a standout signature
Piping hot, packed with soon tofu, delicious
